description: Search Geppetto's directory of 1,000+ robot training datasets by platform, modality, license, or commercial-use. Returns name, slug, platforms, sensor modalities, episode count, hours, license, access type, and URL.

category.description: Dataset type: real-robot, human-video, or sim

commercialUse.description: If true, only datasets cleared for commercial use

embodiment.description: Robot platform used to collect the data, e.g. unitree-g1, franka, aloha, humanoid

license.description: License identifier, e.g. apache-2.0, cc-by-4.0, mit

modality.description: Sensor modality, e.g. rgb, depth, tactile, imu, lidar, force-torque

query.description: Free-text search over dataset name, description, and source

name: search_datasets
title: Search Robot Training Datasets
